description.value: Yudi Patisserrie is a patisserie and bakery located in a unit along Alexandra Road in Richmond, a street known for its dense concentration of Asian food businesses. As a pastry shop it would offer baked goods and sweet items useful for cyclists looking to refuel on a ride through the Richmond area. Its Instagram presence (handle: @patisserieyudi) suggests an active, small independent operation.
